# Trajectory Inference Notebooks (Results 2.3)

Pseudotime ordering and RNA velocity analysis.

## Notebooks

- `cell_cycle.ipynb` – Cell cycle gene analysis (Figure S13)

- `pseudotime.ipynb` – Diffusion pseudotime analysis

- `scvelo.ipynb` – RNA velocity analysis using scVelo

- `scvelo-enrichr.ipynb` – Velocity pseudotime correlations and enrichr analysis
